params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If specified, object is an object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable or a field.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

params.name: variableFrame
params.description: True = Variable frame printing, False = Fixed frame printing

params.name: fixedSubform
params.description: Options for printing subforms in fixed size

sentinelValues.meaning: Print Frame fixed with truncation -- only records that fit in the subform's area are printed once; overflow records are ignored
Print Frame fixed with multiple records -- the frame stays the same size but the form is printed multiple times to include all records

overloads.semanticRole: Sets the Print Variable Frame property (and, only for subforms in fixed-frame mode, the fixed-frame printing option) of the object(s) designated by object and *.

jointConstraints.rule: fixedSubform is only used when variableFrame is False and object is a subform; it is ignored in every other case.

constraints: Has no effect if applied to an object that does not support the Print Variable Frame property (Text/Picture fields and variables, 4D Write Pro areas, and subforms).
